pairs.target: dìèrtiān zài cè wū zuò guò yǐhòu , dàjiā zhōngyú zhīdào pà wò búshì suíkǒu shuō de .
pairs.english: After spending the next day in the side room, everyone finally knew Pavo had not been speaking idly.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天在侧屋坐过以后，大家终于知道帕沃不是随口说的。

pairs.target: zhèlǐ zhēn néng wénjiàn měi yì guōtāng .
pairs.english: They really could smell every pot of soup here.
pairs.hanzi: 这里真能闻见每一锅汤。

pairs.target: dìsāntiān shàngwǔ , jiǎn lǎoshī jiǎng dào yíbàn , hòu chú bǎ yìkuāng yángcōng dǎo jìn règuō , xiāngwèi zhí wǎng ménxià zuàn .
pairs.english: On the third morning, halfway through Instructor Jian's lecture, the kitchen tipped a basket of onions into a hot pan, sending their aroma straight under the door.
pairs.hanzi: 第三天上午，简老师讲到一半，后厨把一筐洋葱倒进热锅，香味直往门下钻。

pairs.target: qiánpái yǒurén dùzǐ xiǎng le , pà wò zhuāngyán dì tì quán wū diǎn le yíxiàtóu ,
pairs.english: Someone's stomach growled in the front row. Pavo nodded solemnly on behalf of the whole room.
pairs.hanzi: 前排有人肚子响了，帕沃庄严地替全屋点了一下头，

pairs.target: lián lǎoshī yě tíngzhù , děng xiàoshēng guòqù cái jiēzhe jiǎng .
pairs.english: Even the instructor paused, waiting for the laughter to pass before continuing.
pairs.hanzi: 连老师也停住，等笑声过去才接着讲。

pairs.target: zhuōzi gāodī bùqí , chuāng yě xiǎo , kě chuāngwài méiyǒu běi gōngfáng nà dǔqiáng .
pairs.english: The tables were of uneven heights and the windows small, but the north workshop's wall was no longer outside the window.
pairs.hanzi: 桌子高低不齐，窗也小，可窗外没有北工房那堵墙。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wǎng wài kàn shí néng kànjiàn yìzhū luò guāng yèzi de shù , zhītóu guà zhe bù zhīdào shuí rēngshàngqù de bù qiú .
pairs.english: Looking out, Tavi could see a tree stripped of its leaves, with a cloth ball someone had thrown caught in its branches.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维往外看时能看见一株落光叶子的树，枝头挂着不知道谁扔上去的布球。

pairs.target: luò héng yòng zhé zhǐdiàn wěn zhuōjiǎo , yòu bǎ liànxíběn wǎng liǎng rén zhōngjiān tuī le tuī .
pairs.english: Lohen steadied the table leg with folded paper, then pushed his exercise book between them.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡用折纸垫稳桌脚，又把练习本往两人中间推了推。

pairs.target: tāmen zànshí zhī zuò dútú hé jìsuàn , jiè xìng liànxí tíng zhe , tiěpiàn réng méi lǐnghuílái .
pairs.english: For now they did only drawing interpretation and calculations. Property-borrowing practice was suspended, and their iron strips had still not been returned.
pairs.hanzi: 他们暂时只做读图和计算，借性练习停着，铁片仍没领回来。

pairs.target: shàngwǔ de kèhòu , wéi lǎoshī dàilái yìzhāng jiǎntú .
pairs.english: After morning class, Instructor Vey brought a simple diagram.
pairs.hanzi: 上午的课后，维老师带来一张简图。

pairs.target: běi yì dìxià yǒu yíduàn jiù tiě gòujià , yuánlái de jiǎnxiū tú bǎ tā huàzuò yǐjīng gékāi de bùfen ;
pairs.english: Beneath the north wing was a section of old iron framework, shown as disconnected in the existing maintenance diagram.
pairs.hanzi: 北翼地下有一段旧铁构架，原来的检修图把它画作已经隔开的部分；

pairs.target: wéihù rényuán zuótiān bā kāifēng céng , què fāxiàn yíchù liánjiē réng zài .
pairs.english: But yesterday maintenance workers had opened the sealed covering and found one connection still intact.
pairs.hanzi: 维护人员昨天扒开封层，却发现一处连接仍在。

pairs.target: tā yòngbǐ quān chū wèizhì , méiyǒu huà jìn tāmen yòng de dēngjià .
pairs.english: She circled the location with her pen. She did not include the lamp stand they had used in the drawing.
pairs.hanzi: 她用笔圈出位置，没有画进他们用的灯架。

pairs.target: " shì tā bǎ tiě huáng nòngwān de ma ? " yǒurén wèn .
pairs.english: “Did that bend the iron spring?” someone asked.
pairs.hanzi: “是它把铁簧弄弯的吗？”有人问。

pairs.target: tā shuō hái bùnéng zhème jiǎng . zhǎodào le méiyǒu duànkāi de liánjiē , bù děngyú yǐjīng zhǎodào biànhuà cóng nǎlǐ lái .
pairs.english: She said they could not say that yet. Finding a connection that had not been severed did not mean they had found where the change came from.
pairs.hanzi: 她说还不能这么讲。找到了没有断开的连接，不等于已经找到变化从哪里来。

pairs.target: xuéjiào zhèngzài xiàng fùjìn jǐgè wéihù diǎn yào qián wǎn de zuòyè shíkè ,
pairs.english: The school was requesting work times from several nearby maintenance sites for the evening before last.
pairs.hanzi: 学校正在向附近几个维护点要前晚的作业时刻，

pairs.target: běi yì réng fēng zhe , shénme shíhòu zhòngkāi , xiànzài bùnéng dāying .
pairs.english: The north wing remained closed, and she could not promise when it would reopen.
pairs.hanzi: 北翼仍封着，什么时候重开，现在不能答应。

pairs.target: tèlún zuòzài hòupái , wèn dēngjià shìbushì jiù búsuàn zhuāngcuò .
pairs.english: Sitting at the back, Teren asked whether that meant the lamp stand had not been assembled incorrectly after all.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦坐在后排，问灯架是不是就不算装错。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī shuō zhuāngpèi háiyào chá , yuánlái de jìlù yě yào bǎoliú .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey said the assembly still had to be checked and the original records kept.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师说装配还要查，原来的记录也要保留。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànjiàn tā chuí xià yǎn , shǒuzhǐ láihuí cèng zhe túzhǐ biān ,
pairs.english: Tavi saw him lower his eyes and rub the edge of his drawing back and forth with his fingers.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看见他垂下眼，手指来回蹭着图纸边，

pairs.target: bìng méiyǒu yīnwèi nàge dìxià de yuánquān jiù qīngsōng xiàlái .
pairs.english: That circle underground had not made him feel relieved.
pairs.hanzi: 并没有因为那个地下的圆圈就轻松下来。

pairs.target: sàn kè yǐhòu , nài lěi zài ménwài děng tǎ wéi , shǒulǐ tí zhe liǎngzhī kōng wǎn .
pairs.english: After class, Nerai waited outside the door for Tavi, carrying two empty bowls.
pairs.hanzi: 散课以后，奈蕾在门外等塔维，手里提着两只空碗。

pairs.target: tā lái zhǎo wéi lǎoshī wèn wéihù de shì , shùndào jiào tā yìqǐ chīfàn .
pairs.english: She had come to ask Instructor Vey about the maintenance work and invited him to eat with her while she was there.
pairs.hanzi: 她来找维老师问维护的事，顺道叫他一起吃饭。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yílù gēn dào shítáng , huà zài nǎozǐlǐ jǐ zhe , zuòxià què xiān wèn tā yào buyào cōng .
pairs.english: Tavi followed her to the dining hall with words crowding his mind, but once seated he first asked whether she wanted scallions.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维一路跟到食堂，话在脑子里挤着，坐下却先问她要不要葱。

pairs.target: " yào . nǐ yě yào , bùxǔ quán bōgěi wǒ . "
pairs.english: “Yes. You want some too; don't pick them all out for me.”
pairs.hanzi: “要。你也要，不许全拨给我。”

pairs.target: tā xiào le yíxià , ná qǐ sháozǐ , hūrán shuō zìjǐ nàtiān hěn pà .
pairs.english: He smiled a little and picked up his spoon, then suddenly said he had been frightened that day.
pairs.hanzi: 他笑了一下，拿起勺子，忽然说自己那天很怕。

pairs.target: tā yǐwéi lǎoshī yìyǎn jiù huì kàn chūlái nǎlǐ bú duì , kě lǎoshī yě dé xiān kàn yíchù , zài kàn lìng yíchù .
pairs.english: He had thought the instructors would see at a glance what was wrong, but they too had needed to look in one place, then another.
pairs.hanzi: 他以为老师一眼就会看出来哪里不对，可老师也得先看一处，再看另一处。

pairs.target: shuōwán tā dītóu jiǎo tāng , pà zhè tīng zhe xiàng zéguài tāmen .
pairs.english: After saying it, he lowered his head to stir his soup, afraid it sounded like blaming them.
pairs.hanzi: 说完他低头搅汤，怕这听着像责怪她们。

pairs.target: nài lěi méiyǒu tì shuí biànjiě . tā wèn tā zuówǎn shuì dé zěnyàng .
pairs.english: Nerai did not defend anyone. She asked how he had slept last night.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾没有替谁辩解。她问他昨晚睡得怎样。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō bànyè xǐng guò yícì , xiǎng tīng yǒuméiyǒu dōngxī xiǎng , hòulái cái zhīdào shì pà wò zài fānshēn .
pairs.english: Tavi said he had woken once in the night, listening for any sound, only to realize later that it was Pavo turning over.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说半夜醒过一次，想听有没有东西响，后来才知道是帕沃在翻身。

pairs.target: nài lěi bǎ yíkuài miànbāo bāikāi , yíbàn fàngzài tā wǎn biān .
pairs.english: Nerai broke a piece of bread in two and placed half beside his bowl.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾把一块面包掰开，一半放在他碗边。

pairs.target: " jīnwǎn yàoshi hái xǐng , míngtiān lái gēn wǒ shuō . "
pairs.english: “If you wake again tonight, come and tell me tomorrow.”
pairs.hanzi: “今晚要是还醒，明天来跟我说。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn tā huì buhuì zǒu . tā shuō zhè jǐtiān zài chénglǐ , zhēn yào chūmén huì gàosù tā .
pairs.english: Tavi asked whether she would leave. She said she would be in the city these next few days and would tell him if she really had to go away.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问她会不会走。她说这几天在城里，真要出门会告诉他。

pairs.target: tā zhè cái bǎ tāng lǐ de cōng chī le , wèidào bǐ gāngcái wén zhe dàn , què ràng wèi lǐ nuǎn qǐlái .
pairs.english: Only then did he eat the scallions in his soup. They tasted milder than their earlier smell, but warmed his stomach.
pairs.hanzi: 他这才把汤里的葱吃了，味道比刚才闻着淡，却让胃里暖起来。

pairs.target: xiàwǔ , tèlún bào zhe yìgēn xīn liáng hé yígè mùkuài dào cè wū zhǎo mǐlā .
pairs.english: That afternoon, Teren brought a new beam and a wooden block to find Mira in the side room.
pairs.hanzi: 下午，特伦抱着一根新梁和一个木块到侧屋找米拉。

pairs.target: zuótiān yuēdìng de guīhuán shíxiàn yǐjīng guò le , jiù jiàn réng liúzài fēngbì de gōngfáng , tā bùnéng jìnqù chāi .
pairs.english: Yesterday's agreed return deadline had passed, but the old parts remained in the closed workshop; he could not enter to dismantle them.
pairs.hanzi: 昨天约定的归还时限已经过了，旧件仍留在封闭的工房，他不能进去拆。

pairs.target: néng lìng zuò de , tā zuówǎn zuò le ; zhǐ shàng de rìqī què méiyǒu zìjǐ huàdiào .
pairs.english: He had made what he could separately last night, but had not crossed out the date on the paper himself.
pairs.hanzi: 能另做的，他昨晚做了；纸上的日期却没有自己划掉。

pairs.target: mǐlā mō guò xīn liáng , rènchū nàtiáo ānfàng huázuò de qiǎn cáo .
pairs.english: Mira ran her hand over the new beam, recognizing the shallow groove for the sliding carriage.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉摸过新梁，认出那条安放滑座的浅槽。

pairs.target: tā bǎ mùkuài gē jìnqù , tuī dào yíbàn jiù kǎzhù .
pairs.english: She set the wooden block inside and pushed it halfway, where it stuck.
pairs.hanzi: 她把木块搁进去，推到一半就卡住。

pairs.target: tèlún shēnshǒu xiǎng jiē , tā méi sōng , zhǐ gěi tā kàn mùwén qiàoqǐ de yìjiǎo .
pairs.english: Teren reached to take it, but she did not let go, pointing out a raised corner in the grain.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦伸手想接，她没松，指给他看木纹翘起的一角。

pairs.target: tā dūnxiàlái , kàn le yíhuìer , shuō dài xiǎo páozǐ lái zhèlǐ xiū .
pairs.english: He crouched, examined it for a while, and said he would bring a small plane here to fix it.
pairs.hanzi: 他蹲下来，看了一会儿，说带小刨子来这里修。

pairs.target: " búshì zhī chà báo yìdiǎn . " tā shuō , " liǎngbiān dé shùn . "
pairs.english: “It's not just a question of being a little thinner,” she said. “Both sides have to run smoothly.”
pairs.hanzi: “不是只差薄一点。”她说，“两边得顺。”

pairs.target: tā diǎntóu , bǎ lìngwài yìzhāng zhǐ fàngzài zhuōshàng .
pairs.english: He nodded and laid another sheet on the table.
pairs.hanzi: 他点头，把另外一张纸放在桌上。

pairs.target: nà shì gěi zhǎnlǎn jìlù bǔ de shuōmíng , xiě qīngyuán móxíng hé jièyòng bùjiàn de lái chù , yě xiě le méi xiān zhēngdé tóngyì .
pairs.english: It was an added statement for the exhibition record, identifying the original model and the sources of the borrowed components, and stating that he had not first obtained consent.
pairs.hanzi: 那是给展览记录补的说明，写清原模型和借用部件的来处，也写了没先征得同意。

pairs.target: mǐlā cóngtóu dú dào wěi , méiyǒu xiàng qiān jiètiáo shí nàyàng lìkè nábǐ .
pairs.english: Mira read it from beginning to end, without immediately picking up a pen as she had when signing the borrowing agreement.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉从头读到尾，没有像签借条时那样立刻拿笔。

pairs.target: " zhège búyòng wǒ tì nǐ qiān . "
pairs.english: “You don't need me to sign this for you.”
pairs.hanzi: “这个不用我替你签。”

pairs.target: " ǹg . " tèlún shuō , " shì wǒ xiěgěi tāmen de . yě gěi nǐ kàn . "
pairs.english: “No,” Teren said. “I wrote it for them. For you to see too.”
pairs.hanzi: “嗯。”特伦说，“是我写给他们的。也给你看。”

pairs.target: tā tíng le yíxià , mùguāng luò zài kōng zhe de cáo lǐ , shuō duìbùqǐ , nàtiān bùgāi jiǎng tā de móxíng búsuàn zhēn yǒuyòng .
pairs.english: He paused, his gaze falling into the empty groove, and apologized: he should not have said that day that her model was not truly useful.
pairs.hanzi: 他停了一下，目光落在空着的槽里，说对不起，那天不该讲她的模型不算真有用。

pairs.target: mǐlā yòng mǔzhǐ mǒdiào yìdiǎn xīn mùxiè , guò le hǎo yíhuìer cái shuō , dài páozǐ lái ba .
pairs.english: Mira brushed off a little fresh wood dust with her thumb, then only after a long while said to bring the plane.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉用拇指抹掉一点新木屑，过了好一会儿才说，带刨子来吧。

pairs.target: děng jiù jiàn ná huílái , tā háishì yào zìjǐ shì .
pairs.english: When the old parts came back, she would still test it herself.
pairs.hanzi: 等旧件拿回来，她还是要自己试。

pairs.target: tèlún zǒu hòu , sū yǐ cóng chuāng biān tàn guòtóu , wèn néng bunéng jiè zhègēn liáng yāzhù tā juǎn qǐlái de zhǐ .
pairs.english: After Teren left, Suyi leaned over from the window and asked whether she could borrow the beam to hold down her curling paper.
pairs.hanzi: 特伦走后，苏苡从窗边探过头，问能不能借这根梁压住她卷起来的纸。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō děng yíxià , xiān diànkuài bù .
pairs.english: Mira said to wait a moment and put a cloth underneath first.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说等一下，先垫块布。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tīngjiàn liǎng rén dōu xiào le , zhèhuí tā méiyǒu chāzuǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi heard them both laugh. This time he did not interrupt.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维听见两人都笑了，这回他没有插嘴。

pairs.target: yīwén wǎnxiēshíhòu dàilái yì xiǎodài kǎo dòu .
pairs.english: Iven arrived later with a small bag of roasted beans.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文晚些时候带来一小袋烤豆。

pairs.target: fùqīn huí zhùchù qián tuō tā sònglái de , lìng yǒu yíjù huà , ràng tā bié dānwù gōngkè .
pairs.english: His father had asked him to bring them before returning to his lodgings, along with a reminder not to neglect his studies.
pairs.hanzi: 父亲回住处前托他送来的，另有一句话，让他别耽误功课。

pairs.target: yīwén niànwán , bǎ zhǐ zhéhuíqù , shuō tú hái méi guà wán , rén dǎo xiān gěi tā bùzhì shàng gōngkè le .
pairs.english: After reading it, Iven folded the paper again and said the map wasn't even fully hung up yet, but his father was already setting him schoolwork.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文念完，把纸折回去，说图还没挂完，人倒先给他布置上功课了。

pairs.target: tā bǎ dòuzǐ dǎo zài jǐgè rén zhōngjiān , liú yíbàn gěi hái zài shàngkè de luò héng .
pairs.english: He tipped the beans out between them, keeping half for Lohen, who was still in class.
pairs.hanzi: 他把豆子倒在几个人中间，留一半给还在上课的洛衡。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi qù qǔshuǐ , chūménshí xíguàn dì wǎng zuǒzhuǎn ,
pairs.english: Tavi went to fetch water and turned left out of habit on leaving the room.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维去取水，出门时习惯地往左转，

pairs.target: zǒuchū liǎngbù cái xiǎngqǐ zhè jiān wūzi de shuǐtǒng zài yòubiān .
pairs.english: After two steps he remembered that this room's water bucket was on the right.
pairs.hanzi: 走出两步才想起这间屋子的水桶在右边。

pairs.target: tā zhéhuílái , tīngjiàn mǐlā zài jiào tā , shuō tā de bēizi hái zài zhuōshàng .
pairs.english: He turned back and heard Mira calling that his cup was still on the table.
pairs.hanzi: 他折回来，听见米拉在叫他，说他的杯子还在桌上。

pairs.target: xīn liáng zhàn le zhuōmiàn yìjiǎo , pángbiān tānzhe méiyǒu suàn wán de tú .
pairs.english: The new beam occupied one corner of the table, beside a drawing with unfinished calculations.
pairs.hanzi: 新梁占了桌面一角，旁边摊着没有算完的图。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ bēizi ná shàng , yòu chūqù le yítàng .
pairs.english: Tavi picked up his cup and went out once more.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把杯子拿上，又出去了一趟。

pairs.target: zhècì huílái , tā yòng jiǎo dǐzhù mén , hǎo ràng sū yǐ bào zhe yíjuàn dà zhǐ xiān guò .
pairs.english: This time, returning, he held the door with his foot to let Suyi pass first with a large roll of paper in her arms.
pairs.hanzi: 这次回来，他用脚抵住门，好让苏苡抱着一卷大纸先过。
